correctness.rationale: For all n>=2, union-domain and union-image disjointness is necessary and sufficient for ambient-empty pairwise composition. Singleton maps ensure cut-family maximality. Ordered-domain selection and positive compositions count every rank cell uniquely. Binomial series yield the rational GF and even-index Fibonacci identity; independent direct enumeration of all partial isotone maps at n=2..5 validates every cell and maximality witnesses.
